description: Official, verified source registry for the NFL Lines & Strategy hub. Every value on the site is traceable to one of these sources. A value with no matching source is left blank and flagged on the Flagged for Review page.

sources.name: NFL Schedules
sources.provides: Fixtures, kickoff times, venues, broadcast, team records for the 2026 season
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; Week 10 (Nov 12-16, 2026) fixtures and records present.

sources.name: NFL Injury Report
sources.provides: Player, position, injury, practice status (DNP/Limited/Full), game status (Out/Questionable/etc.) per team per week
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; Week 10 2026 report present with per-player rows.

sources.name: 2026 NFL Rulebook
sources.provides: Official playing rules, game timing, overtime, halftime, roster/designation rules
sources.notes: Fetched live 2026-11-13; 2026 rule-change table and Rule 4 Game Timing present. PDF: https://static.www.nfl.com/image/upload/fl_attachment/league/tqivdkzt9mu6wdgsh1ku.pdf

sources.name: NFL Player Stats
sources.provides: Player statistical categories (passing, rushing, receiving, etc.) by season
sources.notes: Confirmed via official nfl.com/stats domain; category pages e.g. receiving stats.

sources.name: NFL Next Gen Stats
sources.provides: Real-time location, speed, acceleration, route/carry charts for every play
sources.notes: Confirmed live official domain; play-level tracking data source.

sources.name: NFL Standings
sources.provides: Division/conference/league standings: W-L-T, point differential, division record

sources.name: NFL roster/IR rule update
sources.provides: Injured-reserve return eligibility (four games), practice-squad size, elevation limits
sources.notes: Official NFL.com news; IR/practice-squad rule facts. Cross-check current roster limits against S3 rulebook.

sources.name: Colorado Division of Gaming - Sports Betting Regulations
sources.publisher: Colorado Department of Revenue, Division of Gaming
sources.provides: Definitions of proposition (prop) bet, parlay, straight bet, and required wager records
sources.notes: Official state regulator rulebook; authoritative definitions for bet mechanics.

sources.name: New York State Gaming Commission - Sports Wagering
sources.provides: Proposition wager definitions, wagering-menu control, league restriction/exclusion authority
sources.notes: Official state regulator page; confirms prop-bet definition and menu control.

sources.name: Nevada Gaming Control Board - Regulations 22.060/22.090/22.150
sources.provides: Acceptance of wagers, parlay-card wagers, house-rules approval and recordkeeping
sources.notes: Official Nevada regulator regulation (effective 2026-02-28); parlay-card and house-rule authority.
